root.label: Ivan Toney pleads not guilty to assault charge

events.label: Ivan Toney pleads not guilty to assault charge

slots.name: plea status
slots.sentence: England forward Ivan Toney has formally pleaded not guilty during his first court appearance in connection with an incident in December 2025 at a central London nightclub.

slots.name: bail status
slots.sentence: After the hearing, Toney was granted unconditional bail and will remain free pending his next court date at Southwark Crown Court on October 29.

slots.name: hearing duration
slots.sentence: During a brief 10-minute hearing at Westminster Magistrates Court on Thursday morning, Toney confirmed his identity before firmly pleading not guilty to the charge of assault occasioning actual bodily harm, as alleged by Saver Da Silva.
